title: Accuracy of augmented reality-assisted versus template-guided implant surgery: an in-vitro comparative study
html: This in-vitro comparative study aimed to examine the accuracy of augmented reality-assisted implant placement compared to the conventional drilling templates. Twenty maxillary bone models were used to perform 80 implant placements using two different methods. Every bone model received four implants: two were placed using augmented reality (AR-I), and two using templates (TG-I). AR-I was performed using Microsoft Hololens 2, and TG-I using SMOP Software. Postoperative cone-beam computed tomograms were superimposed with the presurgical planning, measuring the deviation between the planned and placed implant.
